name: Ritvik "RoYalGamr" Goyal
biography: Ritvik Goyal is a Senior Undergraduate in Mathematics and Scientific Computing at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur. He recently worked as a Research Intern at the CISPA Helmholtz Center, focusing on system security research regarding Control Flow Integrity protections like Intel CET. He is a key member of the competitive CTF team Wiredin IITK and actively mentors students in cybersecurity at Programming Club IIT Kanpur.
